scope: Synchronous checked CPU uint32 tensor literals, ranked elementwise arithmetic and private native tensor interfaces.

semantics.types: Exact uint32 tensor literals, ranks zero through three qualified, ordinary tensor functions and scalar lifting in both operand orders. Matching numeric element types are required; no implicit signed/float conversion.
semantics.lowering: Typed numeric identity selects the unsigned checked scalar helpers even though MLIR uses signless i32 tensor storage. All five binary operators and unary +/- preserve uint32.
semantics.arithmetic: Zero-extended 64-bit add/multiply, range checks, ordered subtraction, unsigned division/remainder after zero checks, and zero-only unsigned negation. Empty tensors have no evaluated arithmetic lanes.
semantics.faults: Overflow, underflow, zero divisors and positive-value negation stop evaluation, preserve source location and publish no partial tensor. Dynamic shapes and native input byte counts retain existing validation.
semantics.ownership: Inputs, including aliases/offset/noncontiguous borrowed views, remain immutable. Result allocations settle on success/failure/cancellation, and a retained immutable lease preserves successful cells after invocation settlement.
semantics.gates: Uint32 tensor task modules, reductions/matmul and GPU arithmetic remain rejected. Backend checks reject forged reduction/matmul IR and task modules with unsigned tensor values before publication. No public foreign-memory/wire ABI or tensor CLI printer added.

coverage: independent unsigned 64-bit reference cells
five tensor/tensor binary operators and both scalar operand orders
unsigned unary identity and zero-only negation
signed endpoint and float32 precision crossing values
UINT32_MAX squared handled as unsigned 64-bit intermediate
deterministic random input pairs
rank-zero/one/two/three tensor literals and arithmetic
explicit and nested literal shapes
nontrivial ranked shapes and every empty axis
native pointer alignment displacement, descriptor offsets and noncontiguous strides
input aliases and immutability
late failing element without partial result publication
runtime shape mismatch and dynamic-to-fixed refinement
negative dimension and byte-count overflow validation
result allocation failure and balanced releases
retained result cells after invocation settlement
rank-zero pre-cancellation and ranked poll-triggered cancellation
frontend rejection of negative/out-of-range/ragged/mixed-element tensor source
private backend reduction/matmul gates
unsigned tensor task gate preserves existing executable and IR
Metal numeric target gate
complete prior uint32 scalar/task and int32/float32 CPU/Metal regression

distributed_execution: Not implemented; agreed design-review gate retained.
performance: Correctness/type integration milestone; no tensor throughput improvement claim.
